normative_extracts.quote: Each worker has its own event loop, global scope, and task queues, executing independently from the Window event loop.

pipeline_phases: Worker Event Loop Enqueues Mailbox Task
Zero-Copy Transferable Reply to Main Thread
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: A dedicated Worker runs an isolated V8 isolate and event loop, processing serialized commands sequentially from its message queue and returning results via MessageChannel ports or transferable ArrayBuffers.

production_failures.symptom: Input lag and janky animations despite moving logic to a Web Worker
production_failures.root_cause: Sending high-frequency pointermove events or huge nested JSON objects over postMessage saturates structured clone serialization on both threads.
production_failures.mitigation: Coalesce high-frequency events on the main thread and transfer binary TypedArrays instead of cloning deep object graphs.

production_failures.symptom: Memory spike in Worker during rapid user interactions
production_failures.root_cause: Fire-and-forget postMessage calls queue faster than the Worker can execute heavy queries, creating an unbounded mailbox.
production_failures.mitigation: Track in-flight request IDs and coalesce or drop superseded commands before posting.
